Class MicrosparcKeyPerfect5

java.lang.Object
org.applecommander.bastools.api.proofreaders.MicrosparcKeyPerfect5
All Implemented Interfaces:
ApplesoftTokenizedProofReader
public class MicrosparcKeyPerfect5 extends Object implements ApplesoftTokenizedProofReader
Perform the MicroSPARC Key Perfect checksum V5.

Notes:

  • The V5 routine is called from the V4 routine, so lots of V4 applies here (and isn't part of the pasted assembly -- see V4)
  • Checksums ignore whitespace except for Ctrl+D (spaces are ignored)
  • Lower case is converted to upper case (LINE_BYTES_READ indicates code is being read instead of the line number)
  • When REM is encountered, the REM token goes into the checksum but the REM contents do not
  • Note that CSUM_V5_1 is really more of a temp storage field and not a part of the checksum
  • The values are printed in reverse order (for example, 5,4,3,2)
RUN_V5_CHECKSUM pha
                txa
                pha
                tya
                pha
                lda     CHAR_READ
                ldy     PD_C4_FILETYPE
                ldx     OS_SELECTION
                beq     ]PRODOS           ;0=ProDOS?
                cpy     #$02              ;DOS and Applesoft=2
                beq     ]APPLESOFT
                bne     ]DO_CHKSUM        ;Binary?!
]PRODOS         cpy     #$fc              ;Applesoft
                bne     ]DO_CHKSUM
]APPLESOFT      ldx     LINE_BYTES_READ
                beq     ]DO_CHKSUM
                cmp     #$60              ;Make all text uppercase ($60='a' and end is $7F)
                bcc     ]DO_CHKSUM
                cmp     #$80
                bcs     ]DO_CHKSUM
                sec
                sbc     #$20              ;Uppercase char
]DO_CHKSUM      sta     TEMP_DATA
                lda     CSUM_V5_2
                sta     CSUM_V5_1
                lda     CSUM_V5_3
                sta     CSUM_V5_2
                lda     CSUM_V5_4
                sta     CSUM_V5_3
                lda     CSUM_V5_5
                sta     CSUM_V5_4
                lda     #$00
                sta     CSUM_V5_5
                lda     CSUM_V5_1
                eor     TEMP_DATA
                tay
                lda     CSUM_V5_2
                eor     KEY_TABLE_1,y
                sta     CSUM_V5_2
                lda     CSUM_V5_3
                eor     KEY_TABLE_2,y
                sta     CSUM_V5_3
                lda     CSUM_V5_4
                eor     KEY_TABLE_3,y
                sta     CSUM_V5_4
                lda     CSUM_V5_5
                eor     KEY_TABLE_4,y
                sta     CSUM_V5_5
                lda     CSUM_V5_6
                sta     CSUM_V5_1
                lda     CSUM_V5_7
                sta     CSUM_V5_6
                lda     CSUM_V5_8
                sta     CSUM_V5_7
                lda     CSUM_V5_9
                sta     CSUM_V5_8
                lda     #$00
                sta     CSUM_V5_9
                lda     CSUM_V5_1
                eor     TEMP_DATA
                tay
                lda     CSUM_V5_6
                eor     KEY_TABLE_1,y
                sta     CSUM_V5_6
                lda     CSUM_V5_7
                eor     KEY_TABLE_2,y
                sta     CSUM_V5_7
                lda     CSUM_V5_8
                eor     KEY_TABLE_3,y
                sta     CSUM_V5_8
                lda     CSUM_V5_9
                eor     KEY_TABLE_4,y
                sta     CSUM_V5_9
                pla
                tay
                pla
                tax
                pla
                rts
('@' replaced with ']' since Javadoc uses '@' for other purposes.)
